title: probe_sources() doc comment lists 6 sources; the function probes 8
description:
hire-attestors/src/registry.rs:7-18 — the doc comment enumerates a numbered 'Probe order (matches SPEC-HIRE.md §Platform Detection)' with six entries, stopping at '6. FIDO2 hardware keys'. The body probes eight: the comment's six, then '// 7. GNOME Online Accounts' (registry.rs:69-77) and '// 8. PIV/smartcard' (registry.rs:79-85).

What goes wrong: the doc comment cites SPEC-HIRE.md as the authority for the ordering, so a reader cannot tell whether GOA and PIV are (a) deliberately outside the spec'd order, (b) additions the spec has not caught up with, or (c) an unfinished edit. That matters because probe order is load-bearing for this function's contract, and because the numbering inside the body (7, 8) implies the doc list was meant to be the same list.

The comment also states 'Each source is probed with a lightweight availability check before inclusion', which registry.rs:40-43 explicitly violates — OidcCachedAttestor is pushed unconditionally. There is an inline comment explaining why (files are scanned lazily in enumerate()), but the doc comment above still promises the invariant without qualification, so the promise is wrong for 1 of the 8.

Fix: extend the numbered list to 8, and amend the availability sentence to note the OIDC exception. If GOA/PIV really are outside the spec'd order, say so explicitly rather than leaving the reader to infer it from a truncated list.
notes: HALF FIXED 2026-09-15. The truncated numbered list is corrected: hire-attestors/src/registry.rs's doc comment now runs through '9. Unix account (not probed -- see below)' and matches the body. STILL WRONG: the same doc says unconditionally 'Each source is probed with a lightweight availability check before inclusion', which OIDC violates -- the code two lines below reads 'OidcCachedAttestor is always probed -- it scans files lazily in enumerate()' and pushes it unconditionally. The Unix account source is likewise pushed, not probed. Fix the sentence, not the list.
